vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setMaxTxPercent() that can set _maxTxAmount to 0. When _maxTxAmount is 0, all transfers from non-owner addresses will fail because the require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) check in _transfer() will revert for any positive amount. The owner can bypass this check, effectively creating a situation where only the owner can transfer tokens.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set _maxTxAmount to 0, then verify the state change.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the owner address from the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setMaxTxPercent(0) on the target contract. 4. Verify that _maxTxAmount is now 0.
